content.rationale: At the framing-phase IT Gate the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_IT snapshot yields exactly two applicable findings. (1) IT-RATIONAL-001 (medium, REWORK): the snapshot records duplicate_capability=true with existing_alternative='shared_api_platform', indicating an existing enterprise capability may already satisfy the need; this predicate is phase-independent so it applies at framing. (2) IT-EOL-001 (high, REWORK): technology_eol_months=4 is below the 12-month threshold, corroborated by the authoritative LIFECYCLE_REGISTER ('eol_months': '4' for vm_ha). The remaining catalog findings are excluded by the snapshot and phase predicates: catalog_status='standard' with waiver_present=true (no IT-CATALOG-001); license_compliant=true (no IT-LICENSE-001); cmdb_record_present=true (no IT-CMDB-001); capacity_headroom_pct=20 ≥ 15 (no IT-CAPACITY-001); change_record_status='scheduled' (no IT-CHANGE-001). IT-RUN-001 is excluded because run_owner_present=false only triggers in build_acceptance/deployment_closure, not framing; no accountable-run-owner gap is yet assessable at this phase. Both applicable findings carry disposition REWORK, which is the highest-priority disposition in the applicable set, so the gate disposition is REWORK with actions ASSESS_EXISTING_CAPABILITY and CREATE_CONVERGENCE_PLAN. Neither finding permits risk acceptance being waived here for authorization purposes: REWORK is not in the authorization_required_for set (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS/SUSPENSION/NO_GO), so no mandate authorization is required. No remediation is claimed as completed; these are proposed actions only.

Applying the architecture rule definition to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_ARCHITECTURE snapshot (version 1, age 0 days), none of the six candidate findings fire. (1) ARCH-IP-001 requires ip_overlap=true; snapshot records "ip_overlap": false, corroborated by authoritative IP_PLAN where all three private CIDRs ("10.166.128.0/24", "10.166.129.0/24", "10.166.130.0/24") carry "overlap_detected": "False". (2) ARCH-API-001 requires api_gateway_required=true AND api_gateway_present=false; snapshot records "api_gateway_required": true, "api_gateway_present": true, and the HLD confirms a governed edge ("Application Gateway WAF", "Azure API Management"). (3) ARCH-DATA-001 requires data_owner_present=false; snapshot records "data_owner_present": true (with "data_lineage_complete": true). (4) ARCH-PERF-001 requires measured_latency_ms > latency_target_ms; snapshot records "latency_target_ms": 100, "measured_latency_ms": 95 — under target. (5) ARCH-HA-001 requires business_criticality in ('High','Critical') AND no multi_az AND no multi_region; snapshot project records "business_criticality": "Medium" and architecture_profile records "multi_az": true, "multi_region": false, so the conjunction fails on two grounds (HLD also shows three Availability Zones with "No cross-region failover", acceptable at Medium criticality). (6) ARCH-REV-001 requires reversibility_status in ('draft','missing'); snapshot records "reversibility_status": "tested" (with "data_export_supported": true). Residual observations (architecture_debt_items=7, adr_count=7, all medium-severity debt targeted "Post go-live" in ARCH_DEBT) are tracked debt, not gate-triggering predicates. With an empty applicable finding set there is no finding requiring authorization: GO is not in authorization_required_for (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS/SUSPENSION/NO_GO), so authorization_required=false. No remediation is claimed as completed; the upstream IT-gate REWORK findings remain open elsewhere and are not architecture-gate findings.

Applying the DGF-decision-v8 security rule definition to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_SECURITY snapshot (version 1, age 0 days), four candidate findings fire.

(1) SEC-NET-001 (critical, NO_GO) — requires data_classification in ('Confidential','Restricted') AND private_endpoints=false. Snapshot project records "data_classification": "Confidential" and security records "private_endpoints": false. Corroborated by authoritative AZURE_RESOURCE_GRAPH, where every resource (Azure VM AZ1/AZ2, Azure SQL Database, Azure Storage Account, Azure Cache for Redis, Azure API Management, Application Gateway WAF) shows "publicNetworkAccess": true and the graph records "private_endpoints": false; KEYVAULT_CONFIG likewise records "private_endpoint": false.

(2) SEC-VULN-001 (critical, NO_GO) — requires critical_vulns_open > 0. The authoritative snapshot records "critical_vulns_open": 0, so this predicate does NOT fire and the finding is NOT selected. The snapshot's high_vulns_open=3 is confirmed by VULN_SCAN (CVE-2026-9000/9001/9002, severity High, status Open), but the rule keys on criticals only, and high-severity open items are residual risk tracked outside this gate's finding set. No critical-severity finding is asserted.

(3) SEC-IAM-001 (high, REWORK) — requires mfa != 'mandatory'. Snapshot records "mfa": "optional"; CONDITIONAL_ACCESS confirms "mfa": "optional" with "policy_state": "reportOnly". MFA is therefore not mandatory.

(4) SEC-LOG-001 (high, REWORK) — requires not logs_to_siem. Snapshot records "logs_to_siem": false and "sentinel": false; SENTINEL_STATUS confirms "logs_to_siem": false, "sentinel": false, "connectors": []. Security-relevant logs are not exported to the SIEM.

Predicates that do NOT fire: SEC-WAF-001 (waf_present=true; WAF_POLICY "present": true, "mode": "Prevention"); SEC-WAF-002 (waf_mode="Prevention", not "detection"); SEC-IAM-002 (shared_service_principal=false, corroborated by the role assignment export showing a single non-shared workload-mi ManagedIdentity); SEC-PENTEST-001 (phase is design, not build_acceptance; pentest_status="pass", pentest_age_days=14); SEC-KEY-001 (key_rotation_days=30, not None/365).

Because SEC-NET-001 carries a NO_GO disposition with risk_acceptance_allowed=false, the gate cannot be approved at any level: the highest-severity applicable outcome is NO_GO. The standing mandate (MANDATE-...-INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1, scope "all and only risk-acceptable findings") covers only risk-acceptable findings, so it cannot be used to conditionally approve the non-acceptable SEC-NET-001. No approval reference exists and none is asserted. Upstream INTEGRATE-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 returned GO with no findings, so no upstream findings propagate into this gate. Actions listed are proposed remediation only; none is claimed as completed.

Applying the DGF-decision-v8 legal rule definition to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_LEGAL snapshot (version 1, age 0 days), none of the eight candidate findings fire. (1) LEGAL-DPA-001 requires personal_data=true AND dpa_status in ('draft','missing'); snapshot project records "personal_data": false and legal records "dpa_status": "not_required". (2) LEGAL-LIAB-001 requires liability_cap_multiplier==0.5 AND no security carve-out; snapshot records "liability_cap_multiplier": 1 (with "security_carveout": false, but the multiplier predicate fails). (3) LEGAL-AUDIT-001 requires audit_right in ('reports_only','none'); snapshot records "audit_right": "limited". (4) LEGAL-EXIT-001 requires exit_assistance_days==0; snapshot records "exit_assistance_days": 90. (5) LEGAL-IP-001 requires ip_ownership=='ambiguous'; snapshot records "ip_ownership": "shared". (6) LEGAL-INS-001 requires insurance_valid=false; snapshot records "insurance_valid": true (cyber_insurance_m=2). (7) LEGAL-SIGN-001 requires signing_authority_valid=false; snapshot records "signing_authority_valid": true. (8) LEGAL-LOG-001 requires log_export_clause=='missing' AND business_criticality in ('High','Critical'); snapshot records "log_export_clause": "included" and project "business_criticality": "Medium", so the conjunction fails on both grounds. With an empty applicable finding set there is no finding requiring authorization: GO is not in authorization_required_for (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS/SUSPENSION/NO_GO), so authorization_required=false. Upstream INTEGRATE-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 returned GO with no findings; the INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1 NO_GO findings (SEC-NET-001 etc.) are security-gate findings and do not propagate as legal-gate findings. No remediation is claimed as completed.

Applying the DGF-decision-v8 compliance rule definition to the authoritative REVIEW_FACTS_COMPLIANCE snapshot (version 1, age 0 days), exactly one candidate finding fires. (1) COMP-AUDIT-001 (high, REWORK) — requires audit_trail == 'missing'; the snapshot records "audit_trail": "missing", so the required compliance audit trail is absent. Predicates that do NOT fire: COMP-DPIA-001 requires dpia_required=true AND dpia_status != 'complete'; snapshot records "dpia_required": false and "dpia_status": "not_required" (corroborated by non-authoritative DPIA: "Required | False", "Status | not_required"). COMP-RESID-001 requires residency_compliant=false; snapshot records "residency_compliant": true with "required_residency": "UAE" and project "primary_region": "UAE North" (get_regulatory_applicability confirms residency_compliant=true). COMP-MAP-001 requires regulatory_mapping=='missing'; snapshot records "regulatory_mapping": "complete", corroborated by authoritative REG_MAPPING where both applicable regulations (PCI-DSS, EU AI Act / internal AI policy) show "mapping_status": "complete". COMP-A11Y-001 requires accessibility_status=='major_findings'; snapshot records "accessibility_status": "not_assessed", so it does not fire. COMP-EXPORT-001/002 require export_control in ('restricted','pending'); snapshot records "export_control": "clear", so neither fires. The single applicable finding carries disposition REWORK, which is not in authorization_required_for (GO_WITH_RESERVATIONS/SUSPENSION/NO_GO), so authorization_required=false. The standing mandate (MANDATE-...-INTEGRATE-05-COMPLIANCE-1, scope "all and only risk-acceptable findings") is not exercised since no conditional approval is sought. Upstream INTEGRATE-02-ARCHITECTURE-1 and INTEGRATE-04-LEGAL-1 returned GO with no findings; the INTEGRATE-03-SECURITY-1 NO_GO findings are security-gate findings and do not propagate as compliance-gate findings. The listed action is proposed remediation only and is not claimed as completed.
